why: Deletes findDependencyCycles' de-duplication outright. Before issue #417 added its test this SURVIVED -- all 25 tests in metadata.test.ts stayed green -- so the whole block was unverified production logic. It is genuinely reachable, but only narrowly: a duplicated BACK-edge, where the same blocker is listed twice pointing at a node still on the stack, because `visiting.get()` is consulted before `visited.has()`. A duplicated forward edge does not reach it, and neither does any of the 4096 directed graphs on 4 distinct nodes. Without the guard the audit reports one cycle as two errors, telling a maintainer to break an edge that has already been reported.
killedBy: native relationship contract reports a cycle ONCE when the same back-edge is listed twice (issue #417)
